body: Risk lens: voluntary sa batas does not mean economically optional. If large buyers eventually write SCS levels into supplier contracts, compliance spending can migrate from 'nice to have' into customer-retention cost—especially for smaller suppliers. Pero huwag din i-price in agad ang cyber boom: the article itself says broad buyer adoption is not yet demonstrated and OT is outside direct scope. The investable signal is procurement behavior, not merely the existence of the framework.

claims.text: If major buyers embed SCS levels in supplier contracts, compliance spending could become an economically necessary customer-retention cost even though the scheme remains legally voluntary.
claims.basis: Inference from the article's documented contract-use design and explicit statement that broad buyer adoption has not yet been demonstrated.
